 Meet 'The Body' Standout Sara Boustany
 Rebecca Perlmutter Thu, November 12, 2026 at 3:41 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Sara Boustany attends Netflix's "The Body" S1 special screening at Los Feliz Theater on November 10, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. - Gonzalo Marroquin / Getty Images for Netflix Don't worry, Anya Butler . We have a crush on Elise Zakaria, too.
 During Season 1 of The Body , viewers instantly fell in love with Elise ( Sara Boustany ), a character who fans are already saying walked in 2004, so Glee's Santana Lopez ( Naya Rivera ) could run in 2009. While Elise presents a tough exterior with the rest of the Lions , she shows her heart to Anya ( Kristina Bogic ), her deeply repressed best friend, who's willing to do anything but kiss her.
 As Boustany told Teen Vogue , her character is more open about her sexuality because "Elise has a better sense of self." She added, "That's why Anya makes so many mistakes; she's too caught up in what other people think. Elise doesn't give a f**k."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Unfortunately, things took a turn for Elise as her open dislike for the priest's niece, "Amazing" Grace ( Sofia Wylie ), gets her in a bit of trouble after their ecstasy-driven dance team initiation goes horribly wrong, leading Grace to fall into a coma, with nobody speaking out about the drugs that caused it. Could Elise take the fall? Scroll to find out all about the actress who brought Elise to life during Season 1, the role she originally auditioned for, where you've seen her before, and more.
 Kristina Bogic as Anya, Sara Boustany as Elise, Emily Roman as Claire in episode 101 of The Body. Netflix
 Who plays Elise in The Body ?
 Sara Boustany plays Elise in The Body . According to Netflix, "Boustany originally auditioned for Anya, before casting director Jennifer Venditti quickly pivoted." Boustany recalled, "Jennifer called and said, 'They think you're Elise, we're going to have a callback,' and she gave me some pointers." After that, she knew she was "100% Elise."
 Who is Sara Boustany?
 Boustany is a 23-year-old Lebanese actress. Born in Lebanon, Boustany moved to Florida at a young age and later relocated to Los Angeles as a teen to kickstart her career. According to her bio on Netflix, her "weirdest childhood obsession" was "Lush Cosmetics 'Rose Jam' Body wash," which is so real, and she is "always saying way too much or way too little."
 Sara Boustany as Elise, Kristina Bogic as Anya in episode 102 of The Body Netflix

 What else has Sara Boustany been in?
 Before starring in The Body , Boustany appeared in Hello Beautiful as Isabel, Dolly Parton's Heartstrings as Fourteen-Year-Old Lucy Jane, and PEN15 as Miranda. This is her first leading role in a TV series.
